anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show no active trades or positive P&L, which could indicate issues with strategy effectiveness or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially update AI models or parameters to ensure they are actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate the performance of active trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and mitigate any processes causing excessive load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating insights.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity may prevent the platform from identifying profitable trading opportunities.

recommendations.action: Analyze the effectiveness of current trading strategies and make necessary adjustments.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring strategies are effective is crucial for maintaining profitability and adapting to market changes.
